payload.text: The push of main to local and upstream. No release rides on it: there is one, 3.3.0 (hv directive 1, decision 109). Its first condition is met: 3.3.0's first train is on main since 9ff4b3e9c (2026-11-10). HELD UNTIL three more things are true. hv has answered on client names in the committed record (watchout 34). The estate's controller, agentic-engineering-vc, has granted a build all at the HEAD to be pushed and it has passed, with every seat holding its commits from the build's start to the push. And a Linux preflight at that HEAD on kovacs has passed (hv's ! line in kovacs-sysadm's session). Then devbin-vc pushes local and upstream, fast-forward only, on vc's word naming that HEAD (decision 90). It carries the fixes for 0666, 0668, 0669, 0671, 0673 and 0674. The cut is hv's, once, through devbin's core.
